display.purpose: Mistr identity and concise panel titles without novelty letterforms.

numeric.purpose: Tabular displayed time, numeric frame age, and dBZ values.

shadows.name: instrument
shadows.purpose: Separates the compact control instruments from the map.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Separates the one open transient panel without creating a card hierarchy.

components.name: Radar Toolbar
components.description: The icon-led top-center sequence Mistr, radar site, recenter, and radar view.
components.html: MistrRadar View
components.css: .ds-toolbar{min-height:44px;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(8,11,18,.88);color:#F4F7FA;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.44);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);display:flex;align-items:center}.ds-toolbar strong{font:600 14px 'Barlow Semi Condensed',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.08em;padding:0 10px}.ds-toolbar button{width:40px;height:40px;border:0;border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);background:transparent;color:#F4F7FA}.ds-toolbar button:hover,.ds-toolbar button:focus-visible{background:rgba(255,255,255,.055);outline:2px solid #FFD7E6;outline-offset:-3px}.ds-toolbar [role=tooltip]{position:absolute;transform:translateY(34px);padding:5px 8px;border-radius:6px;background:#080B12;color:#F4F7FA;font:500 12px 'Barlow Semi Condensed',sans-serif}

components.name: Radar Site Browser
components.description: The single searchable browser for all 155 provider-qualified operational WSR-88D sites.
components.html: Radar sites155 WSR-88D STATIONS
components.css: .ds-site-browser{width:360px;max-height:calc(100vh - 154px);overflow:auto;padding:14px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(8,11,18,.98);color:#F4F7FA;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);box-shadow:0 18px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.54)}.ds-site-browser header{display:grid;gap:4px}.ds-site-browser input{height:36px;margin:12px 0 8px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:9px;background:#050506;color:#F4F7FA}.ds-site-browser button{width:100%;min-height:50px;border:0;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);background:transparent;color:#F4F7FA;text-align:left}

components.name: Radar View Menu
components.description: The eye control's compact radio menu with only the two real spatial presentation modes.
components.css: .ds-view-menu{width:132px;padding:6px;border-radius:10px;background:#080B12;color:#F4F7FA;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.52)}.ds-view-menu button{width:100%;min-height:36px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:inherit;text-align:left;padding:0 10px;font:600 13px 'Barlow Semi Condensed',sans-serif}.ds-view-menu button:hover,.ds-view-menu button:focus-visible{background:rgba(255,255,255,.055);outline:2px solid #FFD7E6}

components.name: Playback Bar
components.description: The stable bottom-center control for observation time and playback truth.

components.name: Measured Readout
components.description: Displayed scan timestamp and numeric frame age without normal-state status words.
components.html: 12:29:26 CDT00:41
components.css: .ds-readout{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:#F4F7FA;font:500 13px Recursive,'Cascadia Mono',monospace}.ds-readout small{color:#73E6B2;font:500 12px Recursive,'Cascadia Mono',monospace}.ds-readout--historical small{color:#F4F7FA}

components.name: Inspection Reticle
components.description: A map crosshair paired with a playback-bar dBZ readout rather than a floating tooltip.

narrative.overview: The radar is the stage. Two disciplined control zones frame it: an icon-led radar toolbar at the top and observation time at the bottom.

rules.name: The Weather Separation Rule
rules.body: Cyclorama color never overlays radar pixels or imitates weather severity.

rules.name: The One Panel Rule
rules.body: Only one toolbar panel may be open and it never resizes the map.

rules.name: The Instrument Type Rule
rules.body: Typography earns character through proportion, weight, and spacing rather than novelty letterforms.

dos: Keep the top toolbar responsible for site, recenter, and radar view.
Keep the canonical site browser searchable.
Keep site and view panels anchored and mutually exclusive.
donts: Do not build a permanent sidebar or left application menu.
Do not duplicate the site picker.
Do not present fixed product or tilt facts as controls.
Do not add speculative toolbar icons.
Do not show alerts before alerts exist.
Do not add normal-state Fresh, Stale, Playing, Paused, or Newest text.
Do not wash radar with decorative color.
